column3: Non-Storable Content — expected for API routes and dynamic pages
Retrieved from Cache — expected for static assets served via CDN/Cloudflare
Modern Web Application — informational only, not a vulnerability
Re-examine Cache-control Directives — s-maxage on pages is set by Cloudflare; no-store on API routes is intentional
HSTS — static assets (/_next/static) served by Cloudflare which handles HSTS at edge; Next.js headers() does not apply to static file serving
X-Content-Type-Options — Next.js headers() does not inject headers on /_next/static/* file responses; mitigated at Cloudflare edge
Permissions-Policy — Next.js headers() does not inject headers on /_next/static/* file responses; set on all HTML page responses
Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy / Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy — set on HTML pages; Next.js cannot inject on raw static asset responses
CSP unsafe-inline in script-src — required by Next.js App Router for inline hydration; unsafe-eval removed
